content: Mu Jew naana-matu ka Jew teepu-wi'yoona kemmase petugonno, ka mu Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu gi Jew numu yise meeoo netamma, “Mu sakwa ka ne nanamooatupu tunetammana mayoho, ka Moses numme tuukwepu. Mu kwu'a na'oonnakwitu sakwa natsekea'a. Mu ka 'yoo manese ka mu Jew numu-wa'nesoo manepunnekwu, o'no soo Te Naa mu magwetzoikwu.”
Mu Paul-no Barnabas oo netumoo'oo ka meeoo mu Jew naana-matu unakwe.

Mu Paul-no Barnabas, susumudu mu tunaka'oedyukudu-no nataya Jerusalem-witoo ka umu nananesootuhidu moohedu oowetuoo tubengakwuse, ka mu susumudu tunaka'oedyukudu ka saa'a puusoo gi oo naka toge'yookuna. Umu Paul-no Barnabas yise ka Phoenicia noko Samaria tubewa-too memeana mu tunaka'oedyukudu tuukwemena, ka mu wakwawa'a gi Jew numu ka Te Pabe'e-wi unu tunaka'oedyukuna. Mu tunaka'oedyukudu yise besa nakasokwama.
Ka Jerusalem-wi petugase, mu tunaka'oedyukudu umu pumme moohedu-no besa nesokwama, ka mu nakana ka Te Naa-witu mu waha, ka Te Naa pumme sootuhipu.

Susumudu numu ka mu nanesootuhidu-matu Pharisee mee nananeadu mee unakwe, “Umuoo wakwawa'a Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu sakwa ka tu kwu'a na'oonnakwitu natsekeaku, ka Moses tamme tunetammakupu ka tamme Jew nanamooatupu manena tumayohokuna.”
Umu tunaka'oedyukudu moohedu tunehane oowetuoo nehanekwuse.
Wuna'me umu nanano apegease, soo Peter 'wunuoose mee'e unakwe, “E nanumu, o'nosoo soo Te Naa e pooha nose-kwi meeoo e netamma, mu wakwawa'a ka Te Pabe'e-witu saa'a naka'oedyukudooa.
Soo Te Naa oo sopedakwatoo pumme ka mu wakwawa'a noko ka tu Besa Pooha-matu-ma mu sootuhina tamme tu sootuhi-kwa'nesoo.
Soo Te Naa tamme-wa'nesoo mu matabuepu, mu tuma'emukwana soomu'wa ka mu tunaka'oedyukute.

Mu haa'a gi oo naka tooge'yookute ka Te Naa unnena, mu haa'a mu wakwawa'a tamme nanamooatupu manena mayoho tuungukwu? Umuoo tumayohope unu namanakwe. Tamme puu gi oo mayoho-wa'ne'yoo, umu te nanamooatupu punno'o gisoo. Tamme sakwa gi umu ooka mayoho tuungupana.
Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus te magwetzoina te sootuha'e ka te tunaka'oedyukute. Umu wakwawa'a tamme-wa'ne'yoosoo,” mee soo Peter unakwe.

No'yoona mu numu gi tunemayuoose, ka Paul noko Barnabas nakapunne. Ka mu numu meeoo netamma, “Ka Te Naa numme pooha-maka-ma numme mu wakwawa'a besa mayugweyakwe.” Ewasoo nanabesa tu manepu-witu mu numu tuukwe.
Umu yise ka apekeamakwuse, soo James mu numu meeoo netamma, “E nanumu,
mooasoo soo Peter te tuukwe'e, ka mooe'ugasoo soo Te Naa oo tzapoonne ka mu wakwawa'a tu sootuhina, yise umu-matu wakwawa'a tu dooamu mayugweke.
O'nosoo soo Te Naa tuukwewabe eka toge meeoosoo na'unnedu botugu, soo Te Naa meeoo te netamma,

content.text: ‘Nu ewow mu Jew numu tuma'emukwadu kadoo mayugwekwu. Saa'a yise nu ka mu David nanadooamu sootuhidooa. Ka tooe haga tooe anooase, nu oo mayodadooa.
O'no saa'a mu susumudu numu nu-kwitu naka'oedyukudooa. Susumudu mu wakwawa'a-matu saa'a nu e dooamu mayugwedooa,’
mee soo Te Naa unakwe, o'no gisoo hemma oo manakwe.”

content: Soo James ooosapa yadooadyakwe mee'e, “Yise nu meeoo tusooyukwe tamme sakwa gi unutu-kwikoo mu wakwawa'a tunedyooe ka Te Naa mu naka'oedyukute.

Tamme sakwa umu-matoo tubo mee na'unnedu, ‘Gi hownne'yoo tooe mu gi tumayohona ka mu Jew numu tumayohope. Yoo oo sukwe 'mane: ka mu numu tooe hemma-too tooe nanesootuhidyidu tuka, gi umu-baatu tukapana. Ka nodukwa-gana gi kumma'akoosoo pootamapana. Gi too puupe tukapana. Gi ka hemma tookoo puu-gakoo tukapana tuwazoo.
Yoo sakwa tamme mu mane tuungu mooasoo mu ka yoo tu namanena naka.’ ”

No'yoona mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka pumme moohedu-no meeoo tusooyugwe, “Numme sakwa mu Paul noko Barnabas ka mu nanana yaatu tamme-matu ka Antioch mee naneadu-witoo taya.” Waahoo nanana yise netutzea ka pumme moohedu-nagatu, Silas-no Judas mee nananeadu.
Tubose, umu-noko oo taya, mee'e na'unnedu, “Mu ne nananumu mu ka tunaka'oedyukudu moohedu-matoo natayana: Mu wakwawa'a Antioch-witu tunaka'oedyukudu mana Syria noko Cilicia mee nananeadu teepu-witu.
Numme meeoo tunaka, susumudu numu yaatuoo mu nemooagana mu nesagwa'e ka tooe ha'yoo tooe mu netammana. Numme gi umuoo mu-matoo ta'ya. Gi numme meeoo mumme mu netamma tuungu.
Meno'o yise numme tunehanese, no'yoona meeoo unakwe, numme nanana tunetutzease mu tayakwu. Umu saa'a ne pupua'amu, Paul noko Barnabas-no kemmadooa.
Mu Paul-no Barnabas too'e nagoehoo ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-koobatoo.
Numme yise Judas noko Silas mu-matoo tayakwu. Eka tubope-kwa'nesoo, umu toge maawa'nesoo mu tuukwekwu.
Ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-no numme meeoo sokwama besa mu ka gi numme Jew numu tumayohope mayohona. Yoo'oo suu'mu sakwa mu 'mane.
Ka mu numu tooe hemmatoo tooe nanesootuhidyidu tuka gi umu-batu tukapana. Ka nodukwa-gana gi ma'emukwapana. Umuoo tumayohope mu nagena besa 'manekwu.”
Mu tubope gwuudu ka mease Antioch-wi petuga. Umu tunaka'oedyukudu tunehane, umu yise ka tubope mu geahoo.
Umu yise oo nease, besa sokwama ka besa oo na'unakwe.
Umu Judas-no Silas yise ewow numu nanesootuhi tunedyoo'e. Tu nanesootuhipe-kwitu mu tuukwena, o'no umu unusoo oo naka'oedyukukwu.
Onosoo ka saa'a umu punowsoo kokodyuka.
Paul-no Barnabas Antioch-wisoo. Umu onatu-nosoo ka Te Naa unnena numu tuukwe.
Saa'a soo Paul ka Barnabas meeoo netamma, “Ta sakwa oona mu numu nono'ata-toosoo moga ka Te Naa God unnepu ta wahapu-witoo mu tunaka'oedyukudu nobengena, howga umu meno'o manakwe?”
Soo Barnabas ka tu nanumu John Mark mee naneadu nepina.
Soo Paul gi oo nepetzabena soo Mark gi umu-no tu nummena mamakwu, ka oona teepu Pamphylia mee naneadu-kwi'yoona nobe-kwitoosoo kodyu.
Mu Paul-no Barnabas nanepetukuse, yise susumu'yoonasoo meakwu mee'e tunetamma. Mu Barnabas-no Mark, ka Cyprus mee naneadu teepu-witoo natsemangega.
Soo Paul ka Silas netutzea puno meakwudu. Mu tunaka'oedyukudu mu nanesootuhikute soo Te Naa umu-kooba tueya'e.
Umu memea oona ka tu memeatoo yise ka mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka Syria noko Cilicia mee nananeadu teepu-koobatu nanesootuhi tunedyooemena.
